name: AO SMITH Intelli UV
summary: The A.O. Smith Intelli UV+ is a sleek wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm). Equipped with a 5-stage UV + SAPC purification system and India's 1st Dual Pass UV Chamber , it ensures safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water.
intro: The A.O. Smith Intelli UV is a stylish wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for homes with municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm). Featuring a 5-stage UV + SAPC purification system and India's 1st Dual Pass UV Chamber, it delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water. Its elegant design, touch dispensing, digital LED display, and 4.5L storage tank make it a perfect addition to modern kitchens.

rows: 5 Stage (SCB® Filter + UV Lamp + Silver Activated Post Carbon + Ultra Shield)
India's 1st Dual Pass UV Chamber, Touch Dispensing, Digital Display
